subsection.name: Coordinate with Related Plans
description: coordinate contigency plan development with organizational elements responsible for related plans

subsection.name: Capacity Planning
description: conduct capacity planning so that necessary capacity for information processing, telecommunications, and environmental support exists during contingency operations

subsection.name: Resume Mission and Business Functions
description: plan for the resumption of essential mission and business functions within organizatino defined time period of contingency plan activation

subsection.name: Continue Mission and Business Functions
description: plan for the continuance of essential missin and business functions with minimal or no loss of operational continuity and sustains that continuity until full system restoration at primary processing and/or storage sites

subsection.name: Alternate Processing and Storage Sites
description: plan for the transer of essential mession and business functions to alternate processing and/or storage sites with minimal or no loss of operational continuity and sustain that continuity through system restoration to primary processing and/or storage sites

subsection.name: Coordinate with External Service Providers
description: coordinate the contingency plan with the contingency plans of external service providers to ensure that contingency requirements can be satisfied

subsection.name: Identify Critical Assets
description: identify critical system assets supporting essential mission and business functions

subsection.name: Simulated Events
description: incorporate simulated events into contingency training to facilitate effective response by personnel in crisis situations

subsection.name: Mechanisms Used in Training Evironments
description: employ mechanisms used in operation to provide a more thorough and realistic contingency trainig environment

subsection.name: Coordinate with Related Plans
description: coordinate contingency plan testing with organizational elements responsible for related plans

subsection.name: Alternate Processing Site
description: test the contingency plan at the alternate processing sites
to familiarize contingency personnel wiht the facility and available resources
to evaluate the capabilities of the alternate processing site to support contingency operations

subsection.name: Automated Testing
description: test the contingency plan using organization defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: Full Recovery and Reconstitution
description: include a full recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state as part of contingency plan testing

subsection.name: Self Challenge
description: employ organization defined mechanisms to organization defiend system or system components to disrupt and adversely affect the system or system component

subsection.name: Separation from Primary Site
description: identify an alternate storage site that is sufficiently separated from the primarystorage site to reduce susceptibility to the same threats

subsection.name: Recovery Time and Recovery Point Objectives
description: configure the alternate storage site to facilitate recoveryy operations in accordance with recovery time and recovery point objectives

subsection.name: Accessibility
description: identify potential accessibility problems to the alternate storage site in the event of an area wide disruption or diaster and outline explicit mitigation actions

subsection.name: Separation from Primary Site
description: Identify an alternate processing site that is sufficiently separated form the primary processing site to reduce susceptibility to the same threats

subsection.name: Accessibility
description: idenitfy potential accessibility problems to alternate processing sites in the event of an area wide disruption or diaster and outlines explicit mitigation actions

subsection.name: Priority of Service
description: develop alternate processing site agreements that contain priority of service provisions in accordance with availability requirements including recovery time objectives

subsection.name: Preparation for Use
description: prepare the alternate processing site so that the site can serve as the oeprational site supporting essential mission and business functions

subsection.name: Inability to Return to Primary Site
description: plan and prepare for circumstances that preclude returning to the primary processing site

subsection.name: Priority of Service Provisions
description: develop primary and alternate telecommunications service agreements that contain priority of service provisions in accordance with availability requirements including recovery time objectives

request telecommunications service priority for all telecommunications services used for national security emergency preparedness if the primary and/or alternate telecommunications are provided by a common carrier

subsection.name: Single Points of Failure
description: obtian alternate telecommunications services to reduce the likelihood of sharing a single point of failure with primary telecommunications services

subsection.name: Separation of Primary and Alternate Providers
description: obtain alternate telecommunications services from providers that are separated from primary service providers to reduce susceptibility to the same threats

subsection.name: Provider Contingency Plan
description: require primary and alternate telecommunications service providers to have contigency plan
review provider contingency plans to ensure that the plans meet organizational contingency requirements
obtain evidence of contingency testing and training by providers at organization defined frequency

subsection.name: Alternate Telecommunications Service Testing
description: test alternate telecommuniation services at organization defined frequency

subsection.name: Testing for Reliability and Integrity
description: test backup information at organization defined frequency to verify media and information integrity

subsection.name: Test Restoration Using Sampling
description: use a sample of backup infomration in the restoration of selected functions as part of contingency plan testing

subsection.name: Separate Storgae for Critical Information
description: store backup copies of organization defined critical system software and other secuirty related information

subsection.name: Transfer to Alternate Storage Site
description: transfer system backup by maintaing a redundant secondary system that is not collocated with the primary system and that can be activated without loss of information or disruption to operations

subsection.name: Dual Authorization for Deletion or Destruction
description: enforce dual authorization for the deletion or desturction of organization defined backup information

subsection.name: Cryptographic Protection
description: implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure and modification of organization defined backup information

subsection.name: Tranaction Recovery
description: implement transaction recovery for systems that are transaction based

subsection.name: Restore Within Time Period
description: provide the capability to restore system components within organization defined restoration time periods from configuration controlled and integrity protected information representing a known, operational state for the components

subsection.name: Component Protection
description: protect system components used for recovery and reconstittution
